summary: Browse and search arXiv, keep preprints, and read their HTML versions on your Kobo.
release_notes: Typeset a paper's numbered equations, line up a results table's columns under the headings that name them, carry the mathematics all the way through instead of stopping early, and close the gap before a comma.
user: Somebody who reads preprints and wants them on e-ink.
job: Search arXiv, keep the papers you want, and read them on your Kobo.
offline: Kept papers and your reading places work without the network; searching does not.

data.location: the app's shelf storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; the same search on arXiv fetches them again

data.kind: your reading place in each kept paper
data.location: the app's private storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; it exists so a half-read paper continues

capabilities_required.name: network
capabilities_required.purpose: to search arXiv and fetch the papers you keep

non_goals: It does not fetch paywalled journals.
